description: Step 1 of 2 to publish one of this account's monitors as a public Monity Network tracker (needs an API key with the network:publish scope). Returns exactly what would become public (preview: title, slug, scope, site, cadence, shares[] and doesNotShare[]), whether it is eligible (reasons if not), public trackers of the same page (samePage: suggest following one, or give a scope saying how yours differs), and a revisionId. Nothing is public after this. Show the person the preview and get their go-ahead before publish_network_watch. Create the monitor first with create_monitor if needed; a monitor becomes eligible once it has checked successfully.

category.description: A Network topic, e.g. deals, tech, jobs

monitorUuid.description: The monitor to publish (from list_monitors or create_monitor)

scope.description: What exactly it covers, e.g. "UK store, size 10"

name: preview_network_watch
title: Preview publishing a monitor to Monity Network
